in_marathi.name: Girdhari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who bears the mountain Govardhana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Girdhari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Girdhari is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Gir' meaning mountain and 'Dhari' meaning bearer. Thus, the name signifies one who bears the mountain Govardhana. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna is often referred to as Girdhari as he is believed to have lifted the mountain Govardhana to protect his people from the wrath of Indra.
